messages: ellen: Heads-up from today's usability block: most new accounts stop at the onboarding checklist step 1. They don't understand "Connect a model" vs "Use a sample project". The checklist language reads like infra setup. noah: Observed the same. Users think "Connect a model" requires self-hosting. We should reword to "Choose a model or import a starter" and clarify the hosted option. rita: UX suggestion: replace the single-line checklist item with a compact tile that presents two clear choices: 'Use a hosted model (recommended)' and 'Connect your own'. Each tile should have a 1-line benefit and a small icon. samir: Accessibility: ensure tiles are focusable and keyboard-selectable. Use role="button" on tiles and provide aria-pressed state for selection. Screen reader should announce the short benefit. ellen: Copy variants: A) "Use a hosted model (fast, no infra)" B) "Import a starter project (copy with demo prompts)" C) tertiary: "Connect your own model". Also update tooltip/help text for "hosted" to explain pricing/limits. noah: For analytics, track which path users choose from the first-run checklist and their time to first successful inference. Funnel dropoff at checklist step 1 is concerning. rita: Visual affordance: make the recommended option slightly larger and give it a blue outline. But keep contrast checks for colorblind users. Add a small keyboard shortcut hint: 'Press 1 to choose hosted'. samir: Implementation notes: tiles should be implemented as ``` ellen: Also suggest adding a tiny inline example of what 'import starter' gives you: one-liner like 'Echo bot + prompts + demo endpoint' under the tile. Helps reduce ambiguity. noah: A/B plan: V1 (two-option tiles), V2 (tiles + inline mini-preview gif), V3 (compact radio list + help link). Run for new sign-ups only. Measure choice rate and time-to-first-model-call. rita: Add a11y test cases: tile focus order, aria-pressed toggling, screen-reader label reads heading + one-line benefit. Ensure keyboard shortcut keys don't conflict with other shortcuts. ellen: Action items: ellen -> mocks for V1/V2, samir -> aria implementation and keyboard shortcuts, noah -> add tracking events, rita -> write a11y acceptance checks. I'll file ticket and link mocks. onboarding-bot: Task created: PRO-3602 "Clarify first-run checklist: model selection vs starter import" assigned to ellen/noah/rita/samir. Due 2026-04-08. :white_check_mark: ellen: I'll post mocks in #design-review tonight.
